trouble.title: Troubleshooting
trouble.subtitle: Every section of the Dortania troubleshooting pages (OpenCore, Kernel, Userspace, Post-Install and Miscellaneous issues), summarized from the guide and linked to it. Search for the message you see on screen.
trouble.search: Search an error message or symptom (e.g. EXITBS, Waiting for Root Device, iMessage)
trouble.only_relevant: Only problems specific to my hardware
trouble.no_efi: Open an EFI in the Post-Install tab first, then come back to apply the fix.
postinstall.title: Post-Install
postinstall.subtitle: Optional changes from the Dortania Post-Install guide, applied to an EFI you already built. Every change keeps a backup of config.plist and is checked with ocvalidate.
postinstall.no_efi: Pick the folder of an EFI built by EasyOpenCore (or the EFI folder on your USB drive or ESP) to see its current settings.
postinstall.done: Saved. The previous config.plist was backed up to {0}
postinstall.validation.failed: ocvalidate found problems — check the output below (the backup can be copied back to OC/config.plist)
postinstall.error.no_config: No EFI with OC/config.plist was found in {0}.
postinstall.error.unknown_oc: This EFI's OpenCore.efi does not match any OpenCore release EasyOpenCore can download, so matching binaries can't be fetched. Rebuild the EFI in the Build EFI tab.
tweak.verbose.title: Verbose boot (-v)
tweak.verbose.detail: Shows the kernel log instead of the Apple logo while macOS boots. "macOS Decluttering" removes -v from boot-args once the system works.
tweak.debug_args.title: Kernel panic details (keepsyms=1 debug=0x100)
tweak.debug_args.detail: debug=0x100 disables macOS's watchdog so a kernel panic doesn't reboot the machine; keepsyms=1 also prints the symbols, so you can follow the panic.
tweak.apple_debug.title: boot.efi debug output (AppleDebug, ApplePanic)
tweak.apple_debug.detail: Misc -> Debug -> AppleDebug stores boot.efi debugging to disk, ApplePanic stores kernel panics. "macOS Decluttering" sets AppleDebug to False.
tweak.debug_log.title: OpenCore debug log
tweak.debug_log.detail: "OpenCore Debugging": swaps BOOTx64.efi, OpenCore.efi, OpenRuntime.efi (and OpenCanopy.efi if used) for the DEBUG build of the same release and sets AppleDebug, ApplePanic, DisableWatchDog, Target 67 and DisplayLevel 2147483714, so OpenCore writes a .txt log. Turning it off follows "Disabling all logging": RELEASE files, AppleDebug and ApplePanic off, Target 0.
tweak.gui.title: Graphical boot picker (OpenCanopy)
tweak.gui.detail: OpenCanopy.efi from the same OpenCore build and the Font, Image and Label folders of OcBinaryData's Resources; PickerMode External, PickerAttributes 17 (mouse/trackpad, .VolumeIcon.icns and installer icons) and PickerVariant Acidanthera\GoldenGate.
tweak.chime.title: Boot chime
tweak.chime.detail: AudioDxe.efi and OCEFIAudio_VoiceOver_Boot.mp3 (all the chime needs); UEFI -> Audio with AudioSupport, AudioDevice set to the controller that carries the AppleALC layout-id, the failsafe AudioCodec 0 and AudioOutMask -1, PlayChime Enabled, the guide's gains and SystemAudioVolume 0x46. Needs onboard audio output: USB DACs won't work, GPU audio is hit or miss.
tweak.chime.unavailable: No audio controller with a layout-id in this EFI.
tweak.hidpi.title: HiDPI boot screens
tweak.hidpi.detail: UIScale 2 (HiDPI, generally required for FileVault on smaller displays) with Resolution Max. Current OpenCore keeps UIScale under UEFI -> Output.
tweak.hide_aux.title: Hide auxiliary entries
tweak.hide_aux.detail: Misc -> Boot -> HideAuxiliary hides macOS Recovery and tools in the picker; press Space in the picker to show them.
tweak.launcher_option.title: Boot without the USB drive (LauncherOption)
tweak.launcher_option.detail: LauncherOption Full (Short on Insyde firmware, common on laptops) with RequestBootVarRouting: OpenCore creates its own boot option in the firmware, so Windows or Linux can't overwrite the launcher. Needs OpenCore on the disk's EFI partition.
tweak.advise_features.title: AdviseFeatures
tweak.advise_features.detail: PlatformInfo -> Generic -> AdviseFeatures, the fix for "You can't change the startup disk to the selected disk" when the Windows drive's EFI is not the first partition.
tweak.scan_policy.title: ScanPolicy 0x10F0103
tweak.scan_policy.detail: 17760515, the OpenCore default: file system and device lock, APFS, on SATA, SAS/Mac NVMe, SCSI, NVMe and PCI devices. Off = 0, which makes every source bootable (what the troubleshooting pages ask for when drives are missing).
tweak.secure_boot_off.title: Disable Apple Secure Boot (SecureBootModel Disabled)
tweak.secure_boot_off.detail: The fix for "OCB: LoadImage failed - Security Violation". With Secure Boot on, unsigned kernel drivers can't load and the Default model breaks booting High Sierra through Catalina.
tweak.no_nvram_reset.title: Remove the "Reset NVRAM" entry (ResetNvramEntry.efi)
tweak.no_nvram_reset.detail: Unloads ResetNvramEntry.efi, which provides the picker's Reset NVRAM entry and hotkey. Recommended on ThinkPads: the guide warns they are known to be semi-bricked after an NVRAM reset in OpenCore and recommends resetting NVRAM by updating the BIOS.
tweak.no_nvram_reset.thinkpad: ThinkPad: the Reset NVRAM entry stays removed (an NVRAM reset in OpenCore can semi-brick ThinkPads).
tweak.sip_off.title: Disable SIP (csr-active-config 03000000)
tweak.sip_off.detail: Disables kext signing (0x1) and filesystem protections (0x2), with csr-active-config in NVRAM -> Delete so it overrides the current value. Disabling SIP can break software updates on Big Sur and newer.
tweak.rtc_checksum.title: DisableRtcChecksum
tweak.rtc_checksum.detail: Blocks AppleRTC from writing regions 0x58-0x59, for CMOS resets or safe mode after reboot or wake. The guide says to enable it and try, and to disable it if it doesn't help.
tweak.jumpstart_hotplug.title: JumpstartHotPlug
tweak.jumpstart_hotplug.detail: UEFI -> APFS -> JumpstartHotPlug, part of the fix for "[EB|LD:OFS] Err(0xE)"; Recovery may not boot on Big Sur without it.
tweak.release_usb.title: ReleaseUsbOwnership
tweak.release_usb.detail: For firmware that won't pass USB ownership to macOS ("Waiting for Root Device"). Enabling EHCI/XHCI Handoff in the BIOS does the same.
tweak.npci.title: npci=0x2000
tweak.npci.detail: For PCI allocation hangs when the BIOS has no Above4G option (the guide also suggests npci=0x3000). Don't combine with Above4G.
tweak.igfxonln.title: igfxonln=1
tweak.igfxonln.detail: Coffee Lake iGPU displays failing to wake (10.15.4 and newer, with WhateverGreen 1.3.8+), also listed for hangs near IOConsoleUsers.
tweak.igfxblr.title: -igfxblr
tweak.igfxblr.detail: Black screen after IOConsoleUsers on Coffee Lake and newer laptops.
tweak.agdpmod.title: agdpmod=pikera
tweak.agdpmod.detail: Black screen after IOConsoleUsers on AMD Navi cards. The guide also suggests switching display outputs.
tweak.kext_CpuTscSync.title: CpuTscSync
tweak.kext_CpuTscSync.detail: The fix for macOS frozen right before login (a screwed up TSC) on most systems.
tweak.kext_NVMeFix.title: NVMeFix
tweak.kext_NVMeFix.detail: Proper power management for non-Apple NVMe drives ("Fixing Sleep").
tweak.kext_ECEnabler.title: ECEnabler
tweak.kext_ECEnabler.detail: Battery percentage on laptops without ACPI patching ("Fixing Battery Read-outs").
tweak.kext_RestrictEvents.title: RestrictEvents
tweak.kext_RestrictEvents.detail: Hides the "Memory Modules Misconfigured" notification on MacPro7,1 (not the error itself).
